steps.title: Give Cru files
steps.body: Attach photos, videos, documents or any file to Cru with the paperclip, drop them onto Cru on the PC, or paste a picture. On the phone: camera, gallery, files, or share to Cru from any app. Kanban cards and other items dragged onto Cru work too. Cru looks at pictures, reads text, code and PDFs, and passes files on to a chat when work is needed.

steps.title: Lock the PC with your PIN
steps.body: Ctrl+Shift+L locks the PC app with the screen still visible behind a see-through overlay; Super+Shift+L (the Windows key) shows a full lock screen. Only your PIN unlocks it, or your phone. It can also lock by itself after a set idle time, in the mode you pick. Hey Cru still works as usual while it is locked. Kid mode and the lock now share one PIN, under Settings, Voice assistant, Your PIN and the PC lock.

steps.title: Kid mode: mute and typing
steps.body: The kid screen has a mute button for the microphone and a keyboard button, so a child can type to Cru as well as talk.
